name: Verigate Authority
tagline: AI agents propose payments. Verigate verifies each decision before any wallet hand-off.
description: Describe a payment in plain language. The bundled Verigate Python Executa calls Anna's host LLM through protocol-v2 reverse Sampling to extract exact payment details, resolve ambiguity and flag recipient/purpose mismatches, urgency and prompt-injection attempts. AI is advisory only: Verigate's deterministic policy engine owns ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK and AI findings can only escalate ALLOW to WARN. Missing details stop before policy evaluation. For ALLOW, the user explicitly confirms the exact payment in the App to issue a one-time signed Execution Authorization. A separate confirmation is required before wallet submission; each step is gated by a 60-second App-scoped, one-time approval that direct chat/tool calls cannot create. For native USDC on Base and Ethereum, when the Anna host session exposes an injected EIP-1193 wallet, Verigate ExecutionRouter verifies and consumes the signed permission before that wallet is asked to sign and submit the exact transfer. Without an injected wallet, the app still provides signed policy decisions and authorizations but cannot submit the transaction from that session. Wallet private keys stay in the wallet. Anna does not hold keys. Solana remains policy/authorization-only in this release. A WARN can receive a one-time Execution Authorization only after a separate explicit App UI review of the exact current warning rules; BLOCK can never be overridden. The fresh policy and dynamic authority are rechecked before issuance. Decision Receipts and permissions are verified with Ed25519.
